title: Check: Effect of Concentration on Rate

questions.stem: In an experiment investigating the effect of concentration on rate, three different concentrations of acid are reacted with the same mass of marble chips. The graphs of gas volume vs time all reach the same final volume. Why?

options.text: Because the same concentration of acid was used each time
Because the same mass of marble chips (limiting reactant) was used each time
Because the reactions were all carried out at the same temperature
Because the gas syringe has a maximum volume

questions.explanation: The total amount of gas produced depends on the amount of the limiting reactant, which is the marble chips. Since the same mass of marble chips was used in each experiment, the same total volume of CO₂ is produced. The concentration only affects how quickly this final volume is reached.
